metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD (GTA V Legacy)
metadata.description:
GTA VI-Inspired HUD for GTA V LEGACY (the original PC version, GTA5.exe). By FBICat. Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Some HUD art is taken from Rockstar's official GTA VI media and belongs to Rockstar Games. No GTA VI game files are included.
Need help? This is a fork of FBICat's VI HUD with its own support: discord.gg/C7gE5SHEzH, or a GitHub issue. FBICat's Discord is there for his original mod, so please bring questions about this version to ours. Thank you!
INSTALL - two packages, both to the mods folder 1. This package (the files). 2. GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-RegisterPatch.oiv: registers the HUD's DLC packs in dlclist.xml and raises the gameconfig.xml pools. 3. Optional: GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-Lucia-Legacy.oiv, for Lucia. If step 2 is missing, the HUD tells you in game what is not registered. ViMinimap.asi must end up next to GTA5.exe; the minimap needs it to draw in fullscreen.
What it installs - HUD: scripts\GTA6Hud.dll + scripts\Hud\ (art, sounds, data) + scripts\GTA6Hud.ini - dlcpacks:/vihudfonts/ pause menu, HUD art and fonts, vehicle maker emblems - dlcpacks:/vihudanims/ body carry / loot animations, the crawl - 3D minimap: scripts\ViMinimap.dll + MiniMap.* data + ViMinimap.asi (in-game drawing) - 2.5 features (separate scripts; GTA6Hud.dll is FBICat's, with one 2-byte fix: no automatic Lucia swap): scripts\ViExtras.dll + scripts\ViExtras\ + ViExtras.ini honor, crosshair, focus, skills, NPC memory, crash cam, binoculars, radio, nitrous, wanted stars and box, police lights scripts\ViWasted.dll + ViWasted.ini WASTED / BUSTED scripts\ViCustoms.dll + scripts\ViCustoms\ + ViCustoms.ini Leonida Customs (GPL-3) scripts\ViCrouch.dll + scripts\ViCrouch\ + ViCrouch.ini crouch and crawl (GPL-3) scripts\ViSwitch.dll character switching: Michael, Franklin, Trevor and Lucia - No music: put your own mp3/wav files in scripts\Hud\Music and scripts\Hud\Radio\CustomMusic
Changes in 2.5.3 - Switching to Michael, Franklin and Trevor works again, from the HUD's character wheel and with F5-F7, with the game's own sky camera. Lucia switches through the sky too ([Lucia] Enabled = True, the default).
Changes in 2.5.2 - Enhanced: GTA6Hud's own messages show ("Not enough money.", "Lose the cops first." ...), and its error log no longer fills up with the same error every 10 s. - Leonida Customs always lets you go when it closes, and leaving with Esc / B held no longer opens the pause menu or the cinematic camera. - Radio: your own music goes quiet over the pause menu and cutscenes, your car keeps its station when you get out, and D-pad Down in the radio wheel no longer opens the character wheel. - A nitrous kit changed in the shop works at once. - Standing still with the weapon wheel, a menu or the phone open near a cop no longer counts as giving up. - Steadier police, crouch and vehicle card scripts.
Changes in 2.5.1 - Lucia is a separate download now: GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-Lucia-Legacy.oiv (install it after this one and the RegisterPatch). This package is the HUD alone, and much smaller. - WASTED / BUSTED show every time, not just once a session, and frame the vehicle when you die in one. - Lucia: no more freeze when you load a save you quit as her. She only changes from the character wheel now. - Nitrous is on Left Shift (X / Square on a pad); Left Alt is GTA's character wheel. - Police only shoot to kill when you're armed at 3+ stars; otherwise they tase and arrest you. - Binoculars are on the weapon wheel (hold Tab, or LB on a pad), not on B. - GTA's own on-foot camera: no zooming in when you aim or fire, and V zooms out again. - The crawl moves its legs: each knee draws up as the opposite arm reaches, then pushes.
Changes in 2.5 (full list: CHANGELOG.md on GitHub) - Ported from the FiveM version: WASTED / BUSTED, honor, crosshair and kill marks, Focus, skills and gym, NPC memory, the FiveM crash cam, binoculars and radio, nitrous (in a car with a bottle), Leonida Customs (drive into an LS Customs garage), crouch (Left Ctrl twice) and crawl (Right Ctrl), the four-state wanted stars and wanted box, and directional police lights. - Fixed: Legacy black screen after dying; wanted box flickering; a crash while driving (traffic variety is off). - Lucia is no longer lent to the story characters near mission markers ([Lucia] MissionRange = 0). - Legacy: a lighter Lucia ped pack, so she no longer crashes outdoors while the world streams in.
Requirements (not included): Script Hook V, Script Hook V .NET 3, OpenIV with the mods folder (OpenIV.asi).
Known conflicts - Other add-on ped packs (AddonPeds, arthurmichael, big ped packs) and large map/arena packs use up the same game limits; if the game crashes (especially when switching to Lucia), disable those first. Known conflict: MzbArena. - Your progress lives in scripts\Hud\Save and is never touched by the package. - Problems: scripts\GTA6Hud.perf.log, scripts\GTA6Hud.error.log and scripts\MiniMap.log say what went wrong.
https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
